_comment: Guided tour for the metadata editor.

steps.title: What this does
steps.text: The metadata editor fills the structured fields of a measurement — sample, dyes, buffer, instrument — the values every downstream tool (BURST, QuEst, MMFDB) reads.

steps.title: Sample
steps.text: Sample name, construct, concentration and buffer describe what was measured.

steps.title: Dyes
steps.text: Donor and acceptor names must match the dye repository's spelling exactly — a typo silently disables per-dye corrections.

steps.title: Instrument
steps.text: Instrument, detectors and excitation details record how it was measured.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Press Save: the metadata is written to the measurement's record and travels with the .pto project and any MMFDB deposit.
